description: Customer support issues: actionable open issues and actual resolution history. Orphan open issues without an active subscription and issues closed because the customer churned are excluded from all ordinary Agent reads. Actual operations-resolved history remains visible, even after customer churn.

columns.issue_id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY — Unique issue ID (auto-incrementing)
columns.group_id: TEXT — Customer segment group identifier (e.g., S1, E1)
columns.open_day: INTEGER — Simulation day when the issue was created
columns.days_open: INTEGER — How many days the issue has been open (increments daily)
columns.resolved_day: INTEGER — Simulation day when resolved (NULL if still open)
columns.resolution_type: TEXT — 'ops_resolved' for actual operations resolution, NULL while open. Lifecycle closures due to customer churn are archived privately, not returned by public queries.
